messages:
ana_cs: Quick sync  CatalystAI dedicated bring-up tomorrow 8:30am PT. Scope: quota signoff, autoscale smoke, 15m canary + short spike. Need eng, ops, SRE.

peter_eng: I'll handle model pin and perf checks. Which model/targets?

ana_cs: Model: redwood-chat-medium-8k:quant-v1 pinned. Targets: steady 16 RPS ~1100 tok/s. Canary: 8m at 4 RPS, 45s spike to 30 RPS, then 12m steady 16 RPS.

mohit_ops: Autoscale policy: cat-autoscale-1 min=1 max=6 scale_up_on_gpu>70% 60s. We'll enable burst +2 for spike window and keep ops on-call.

ivy_sre: I'll add alerts: p95>200ms, p99>380ms, error_rate>1% -> auto-fallback to hosted route. Also kv-cache eviction monitor. If p99 breaches twice in 5m, we abort.

peter_eng: Perf runner: small locust. Priming: warm KV with top 40 prompts 20m prior at low rate. I'll paste script before run.

claire_cust: I'll be on. Note from renewal team: if cost >15% vs forecast, flag immediately. We'll capture per-route token counts.

ana_cs: Actions: 1) peter 6 perf: push locust + priming payload. 2) mohit: set cat-autoscale-1 + burst. 3) ivy: dashboards + rollback hooks. 4) claire: provide top prompts and forecast. Sync 8:15am PT in #customer-success.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: catalyst-canary-1765439999 at 2024-09-01T15:30:00Z. Owner: peter_eng.

peter_eng: Will post results CSV and a 3-line summary after the run. If we see tail regressions, I'll spin a latency-optimized variant.

mohit_ops: Ops on standby for manual +1 nodes if sustained GPU>85% for 2m. Otherwise let autoscale act.

claire_cust: We'll fill feedback form after run. Thanks team.

ivy_sre: I'll open an incident channel if rollback happens and drop postmortem template link.

ana_cs: Great  see you at 8:15. :thumbsup:
